modalities.evidence: This dataset contains fMRI data from adults

output.population: Adults who consented to share de-faced brain images; 16 subjects in Experiment 1 and 29 in Experiment 2
output.summary: Adult fMRI data from two experiments on violations of physical and psychological expectations, with anatomical and functional images plus event files. Tasks include violation-of-expectation, motion perception, and spatial working memory localizers.
